parameters.content:
## Appointment Reminders (template)
Test mode is ON by default (data/config.json). Nothing is sent: would-be texts go to data/logs/outbox.jsonl.

1. POST appointments to /webhook/appointment
2. Every 15 min, due 24h and 2h reminders are found (quiet hours, opt-outs, once-only).
3. Replies: C confirm, R reschedule, 'cancel...' and 'running late' alert the owner, STOP/HELP shared with all automations.

main.node: TEST: Log Would-Be SMS + Owner Alert
